protocol.humanProtocol: Separate preregistration required before examining held-out participant data.
limits: Synthetic motions are not participant data.
Geometry replay omits DOM, trusted events, user activation, and site compatibility.
Selector-only results do not predict shipped click behavior.
Development seeds are already visible and cannot become a confirmatory test set.
The replay does not model a browser turning a moving press on a link into a drag.
Protocol 2 changed the press rule after the development seeds had been seen. These seeds cannot confirm it.
Every scripted press comes after 0.3 to 0.6 seconds of hovering and lasts 0.08 to 0.16 seconds, so shake is almost always measurable and the 0.6 second and 1.2 second rules are never exercised.
The synthetic tremor is a clean 4 to 7 Hz sinusoid, which is the easiest case for the shake measurement.
